plugins.name: shedkeeper
plugins.description: A safety net for the work an AI coding agent (Claude Code) does on your files and databases: a verified copy before the changes it recognizes (what it does not see: Borders in the README), the trash instead of deletion, a dump of a PostgreSQL or SQLite database before data is destroyed, a way back by your word.
